title: Collection imagery: the Landscapes and Earth and sky candidate sheets for the owner's review
acceptance: A rerunnable, keyless harvest (scripts/harvest-landscape-candidates.mjs) writes src/content/landscapes/candidates.generated.json: Landscapes (Cleveland CC0 paintings and photographs, Rijksmuseum public-domain photographs) and Earth and sky (ESO's night landscapes cut from Astronomy, NASA's Earth). Every API field is validated and bounded; every image is probed; each work's licence class and chip are composed by artwork-label.js.

The owner reviews both sets by eye at docs/assets/live/landscape-review.html on the dev server: Keep, Cut and a note per card, keyboard K, C, U, N and arrows, counts per set, a filter, decisions kept in the browser and downloaded as landscape-decisions.json.
Nothing is wired into a room: no manifest entry, no pins file, no runtime change. The pins come from the owner's downloaded decisions in a later step.
Human gate: the owner's keep-or-cut decisions on both sheets.

evidence.note: Branch imagery-landscapes-candidates. node --test scripts/harvest-landscape-candidates.test.mjs: 10 passed (URL host and credential refusal, plain bounded text, pixel bounds, open/CC BY/NASA credit composition, Rijksmuseum image rights). harvest-science.mjs moved onto scripts/lib/collection-feeds.mjs: its ESO and NASA output is byte-identical before and after (--no-verify, 100 and 75 works). node scripts/ci-hygiene.mjs clean.

Agent observation, not a human's. Harvest of 2026-10-26, every image probed: Landscapes 180 (Cleveland paintings 100, Cleveland photographs 50, Rijksmuseum photographs 30), Earth and sky 78 (ESO 38, NASA 40); licences open 180, cc-by 38, public-domain-credit 40. Page rendered by Playwright on the dev server at 1440x900 and 390x844: no horizontal overflow, no console errors; K, C, a note, the Kept filter, reload persistence and the downloaded landscape-decisions.json all worked.

Agent finding, not fixed here: the Reader's Rijksmuseum adapter tests for a public-domain address anywhere in the VisualItem, which also carries its metadata record's CC0, so it admits In Copyright images (reproduced offline; live example rijks:200114544, image InC, metadata CC0). The harvest reads VisualItem.subject_to instead.

activity.summary: Created and built on branch imagery-landscapes-candidates from the LIVE-IMAGERY owner decisions. Draft PR; not merged, not deployed, not reviewed by the owner.

summary: Candidate sheets for Landscapes (180) and Earth and sky (78), harvested keyless with rights frozen at harvest, and a review page for the owner's keep-or-cut decisions.
